rewrite_provenance.changed: Rewritten on the new Regex.match_full and Match.group_int: the direct-child files are kept, each name is full-matched against IMG_(\d+)\.jpeg, the match records are sorted by their Int capture, and each target name zero-pads with the PadLeft interpolation spec. Failures propagate through run's default Err contract instead of explicit panics. Output and counters are unchanged.
rewrite_provenance.matched: Same generated photos directory: direct children named IMG_<digits>.jpeg, numeric-suffix order with stable filename ties, 300 renames, 100 skipped non-directories, rename side effects, and exact transcript as Python, Rust, and Node.
rewrite_provenance.measurement: The output is byte-identical to expected.out on the generated photos directory. PortBars --measure counts 132 Jet source tokens against 133 for main.py.
